about: The collecta of the formulary “Fifth Sunday after Easter” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, from Whom all good things proceed, grant to Thy suppliants that by Thy inspiration we may think what is right and by Thy guidance accomplish it. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
